stemMd: The audience had heard several extravagant promises fail, so it greeted the new announcement with understandable ______.
explanationMd: Previous failed promises provide grounds to doubt another announcement. Scepticism captures this evidence-based hesitation, rather than simply lack of interest.

distractorRationale.d: The sentence implies a reasoned distrust, not absence of interest.
distractorRationale.a: Celebration ignores the reason for doubt.
distractorRationale.b: Past failure gives no reason for increased submission.
distractorRationale.c: Past failures would not support unquestioning belief.
